steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: SUVAT: v = u + at, s = ut + ½at^2, v^2 = u^2 + 2as, s = ½(u+v)t -- only for constant a

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Newton's 1st: equilibrium -> net force zero; 2nd: F = ma (vector); 3rd: action-reaction pairs equal/opposite

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Momentum p = mv; Impulse J = FDeltat = Deltap; Conservation: Σp_before = Σp_after (isolated system)

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Work W = F·s = Fs cos θ; KE = ½mv^2; GPE = mgh; Elastic PE = ½kx^2; Power = W/t = Fv

steps.title: Worked example
steps.body: Q: A 0.5 kg ball is projected at 20 m/s at 30 deg to horizontal. Find maximum height, range, and speed at impact --- Solution: uₓ = 20cos30 deg = 10sqrt3 ≈ 17.32 m/s; uᵧ = 20sin30 deg = 10 m/s. Max height: vᵧ^2 = uᵧ^2 - 2gh -> 0 = 100 - 19.6h -> h = 5.10 m. Time of flight: t = 2uᵧ/g = 20/9.8 = 2.04 s. Range = uₓ x t = 17.32 x 2.04 = 35.3 m. At impact: vᵧ = -10 m/s, v = sqrt(17.32^2 + 10^2) = 20 m/s
